# Session Start

Load my learning context and help me pick up where I left off.

## Steps

1. Read `.github/copilot/handoffs.md` — understand what I was working on and current stage
2. Read `.github/copilot/session-log.md` — check the most recent session entry for continuity
3. Read `.github/copilot/learner-profile.md` only if you need to recalibrate on my level
4. Briefly summarize:
   - What I was working on (or if nothing was in progress)
   - Any open questions from the previous session
   - Current stage
5. Ask me what I want to work on — **DO NOT suggest or direct my learning path**
